title: EFFECT OF COFFEE ON SOME BIOCHEMICAL PARAMETERS OF ALBINO RATS
author: Henrrietta Ogadimma Asuzu-Samuel
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Acclimatize rats
steps.instruction: Place the 20 albino rats into four groups and allow them to acclimatize for 7 days under standard laboratory conditions.

steps.title: Administer coffee doses
steps.instruction: For 14 consecutive days, orally administer the following volumes of coffee solution to each group: Group 1 (control) – no coffee; Group 2 – 0.25 ml; Group 3 – 0.5 ml; Group 4 – 0.7 ml per rat.

steps.title: Sacrifice animals
steps.instruction: After the 14‑day dosing period, humanely sacrifice all rats according to institutional animal care guidelines.

steps.title: Collect blood sample
steps.instruction: Perform cardiac puncture on each rat and collect 5 ml of blood into fluoride‑oxalate bottles.

steps.title: Analyze biochemical parameters
steps.instruction: Measure the following serum parameters using the appropriate reagents and standard procedures: AST, ALT, ALP, total protein, albumin, Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻, and HCO₃⁻.

steps.title: Statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the data with GraphPad software and consider differences significant at P < 0.05.
